findings.title: Hardcoded file paths
findings.detail: The script uses hardcoded file paths for reading and writing data, which can lead to issues in different environments and is a prohibited practice.

findings.title: Inadequate handling of PD bands
findings.detail: The cut function does not include the upper limit of the last bin (1.0), which may lead to misclassification of PD values equal to 1.0.

findings.title: Potential NA values in limit calculation
findings.detail: If the PD value is NA, the corresponding limit will also be NA, which is not handled in the script, potentially leading to incorrect limit assignments.

findings.title: Income multipliers may introduce bias
findings.detail: The use of fixed income multipliers based on PD bands may inadvertently introduce bias against certain income groups, affecting fairness in credit limit assignments.
findings.code: mult <- c(A = 0.30, B = 0.25, C = 0.15, D = 0.08, E = 0)       # income multipliers, 2019 strategy deck

findings.title: Lack of version control for strategy
findings.detail: The script does not include any versioning or documentation of changes to the strategy, which is important for governance and audit purposes.

findings.title: Potential exposure of sensitive data
findings.detail: The output file path for limits is hardcoded and may expose sensitive data if the script is run in an unsecured environment.
